player_match_results AS (
    SELECT 
        player_api_id,
        team_side,
        home_team_goal,
        away_team_goal,
        CASE 
            WHEN team_side = 'home' 
                THEN CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'win' WHEN home_team_goal < away_team_goal THEN 'loss' ELSE NULL END
            ELSE CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 'win' WHEN away_team_goal < home_team_goal THEN 'loss' ELSE NULL END
        END as match_result
    FROM all_participations
    WHERE (team_side = 'home' AND home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND away_team_goal IS NOT NULL)
       OR (team_side = 'away' AND home_team_goal IS NOT NULL AND away_team_goal IS NOT NULL)
),
player_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        player_api_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_result = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as losses
    FROM player_match_results
    GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT 
    'Winner' as category,
    p.player_name,
    ps.wins,
    'winning matches' as match_type
FROM player_stats ps
JOIN Player p ON ps.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE ps.wins = (SELECT MAX(wins) FROM player_stats)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Loser' as category,
    p.player_name,
    ps.losses,
    'losing matches' as match_type
FROM player_stats ps
JOIN Player p ON ps.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE ps.losses = (SELECT MAX(losses) FROM player_stats)
ORDER BY category, match_type
